I can’t reliably calculate the final permutation by hand. This Python snippet will execute the assignments and print the values; paste the full assignment sequence into `code`:

```python
import re

values = {
    "a": 46, "b": 9, "c": 64, "d": 38,
    "e": 4, "f": 95, "g": 67, "h": 99, "TMP": 34,
}

code = """PASTE THE ASSIGNMENTS HERE"""

for target, source in re.findall(r"(\w+)\s*<-\s*(\w+)", code):
    values[target] = values[source]

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in
                ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")))
```
